text: 1960 gated inner font registration with the global hasLoaded flag inside the existing iframe load listener. Accepted code still listens for iframe load but records __UIFontRegistered on that iframe window, while hasLoaded guards the outer window/tree. Keep these two object lifetimes separate. The current comment reports asynchronous sub-page loads can overlap; this is a bounded current refinement, not full study of the later migration or proof that every listener is registered once. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: The iframe font-registration guard differs from the outer tab guard
